description: This file defines functions and macros for retrieving all values associated with a map in CMake scripts. It includes a function 'map_values' that returns values for specified keys or all values if no keys are provided, and a commented-out macro 'map_values' intended for faster execution.

methods.name: map_values
methods.description: Retrieves all values from a map for specified keys or all values if no keys are specified.
